title: UpdraftPlus Backup Setup
description: Configure UpdraftPlus for automated off-site backups, retention, and restore readiness.

steps.title: Set Backup Schedule
steps.instructions: Schedule database backups daily and file backups weekly (or per client SLA). Avoid peak traffic windows on shared hosting.

steps.title: Connect Remote Storage
steps.instructions: Link S3, Google Drive, Dropbox, or another off-site destination. Test authentication and folder permissions.

steps.title: Configure Retention Policy
steps.instructions: Set how many daily, weekly, and monthly backups to keep. Balance storage cost with recovery point objectives.

steps.title: Exclude Cache & Large Logs
steps.instructions: Exclude cache directories, backup folders, and oversized logs from file backups to keep archives lean and fast to restore.

steps.title: Enable Backup Encryption (If Required)
steps.instructions: Turn on encryption for sensitive client data. Store the decryption passphrase in the agency password vault—not in email.

steps.title: Run Manual Backup Before Go-Live
steps.instructions: Take a full manual backup before launch or major changes. Confirm the archive appears in remote storage.

steps.title: Test Restore on Staging
steps.instructions: Restore the latest backup to staging. Verify posts, uploads, plugins, and admin login work after restore.
